headline: Share & Learn
keyMessage: Share & Learn enhances community sharing with a place to keep what community shares
problem: We share songs, recipes, books, useful links, ideas, experiences and more every day. But in chats and messages, valuable things quickly get buried.
purpose: Share & Learn gives them a place where you can save, organize, share and rediscover them with the people who matter.

why.heading: Why Share & Learn?
paragraphs: Keep talking and sharing wherever you already do. When something is worth keeping, bring it to Share & Learn — where it stays easy to find, share and learn from.

points.title: Share within Circles
points.copy: Create spaces for family, friends and communities.

points.title: Organize your way
points.copy: Use folders when you need them.

points.title: Learn from each other
points.copy: Keep discussions, experiences and tips with what was shared.

points.title: Find it again
points.copy: Search, browse or save something to your library for later.

communities.heading: Built around your community
paragraphs: Every community is different. A family might share recipes and memories. A music group might share songs. A learning group might share books, articles and ideas.
You and your community decide what matters.

closing: Share what you Learn! Keep what you Share!
